about: NavisLabs launch film — V5 copy: the single source of truth for every spoken and on-screen word. The 26 voice lines are the founder-approved script (wording fixed; timings locked to the V4 picture). scripts/build-film-data.py reads this file; nothing else defines copy. Entities (names, dates, customers) come from navislabs_demo_data.json.

products.name: Navis App
products.for: people inside an organization: what changed, why it matters, waiting on you; prepares actions for a person to review and approve

products.name: Navis Developer
products.for: developers, AI agents, teams and solo builders: company context over MCP / API / SDK / CLI, cited facts with source and freshness, permission checks, recorded runs

never: a learning / outcome loop that is already built

voice_direction: Abhishek Meena's own voice (or an ElevenLabs clone of it made with his permission). Calm, deep, precise, technical, confident, understated, founder-led — natural to Abhishek's own accent. Not a commercial announcer, trailer voice, AI voice, overly American, overly dramatic, or fast social-media narration.

voiceover.text: Your people and agents see different truths.
voiceover.visual: PEOPLE | AI AGENTS: the same customer, two truths. The person's inbox says Acme's renewal moved to Nov 28; the agent's workflow file still says Nov 14.
voiceover.delivery: low, unhurried; even weight; land 'different truths'

voiceover.text: The truth is scattered across the systems where work happens.
voiceover.visual: The two views break apart: the truth sits across Gmail, Calendar, Meet, Drive, Docs and Slack — a piece in each.

voiceover.text: People rebuild it by hand. Agents start without it.
voiceover.visual: PEOPLE copy by hand | AGENTS: empty session.
voiceover.delivery: two clean sentences; short beat between

voiceover.text: Navis turns those signals into one shared understanding.
voiceover.visual: NavisLabs mark + wordmark, then the line branches into the two products: Navis App and Navis Developer.
voiceover.delivery: say 'Navis' clearly, then let the line open
voiceover.pronunciation: Navis: confirm with the founder (current note: NAV-iss /ˈnævɪs/)

voiceover.text: Every email, meeting, document and message becomes a signal —
voiceover.visual: Live systems emit signals; they settle into memory.
voiceover.delivery: list with even rhythm; lift on 'signal'

voiceover.text: remembered, connected, and turned into what should happen next.
voiceover.visual: Memory → context → intelligence → decision → execution → outcome (building) → learning (next).

voiceover.text: Inside a company, the Navis App is for people.
voiceover.visual: The company → teams → people → customers · projects · commitments → where the work lives → the Navis App opens.
voiceover.delivery: warm, plain; name the product clearly

voiceover.text: It shows what changed — Acme's renewal moved.
voiceover.visual: Your attention → What changed: Acme's renewal moved.

voiceover.text: And why: every fact with its source, its time, and how fresh it is.
voiceover.visual: Why this matters → evidence rows with source, time, freshness → one customer state.

voiceover.text: It's waiting on you, so Navis drafts the reply.
voiceover.visual: Waiting on you → Review & reply → Review draft → the draft.

voiceover.text: A person decides.
voiceover.visual: Abhishek selects a sentence and writes his own.

voiceover.text: Then the company acts.
voiceover.visual: Approve & send → Sending → Gmail accepted → Reply sent.

voiceover.text: The same company's agents use Navis Developer.
voiceover.visual: Light → dark: VS Code and Claude Code on the same company's repository; the agent lacks context.

voiceover.text: Invite the team. Connect once — MCP, API, SDK or CLI.
voiceover.visual: Add a member → Invited; claude mcp add → ✓ Connected; Console › Connect.
voiceover.pronunciation: MCP: em-see-pee; API: ay-pee-eye; SDK: ess-dee-kay; CLI: see-el-eye

voiceover.text: The agent asks — and gets cited facts, with their freshness.
voiceover.visual: navis_get_relevant_context → five facts with source and freshness.

voiceover.text: Navis isn't the model. It supplies the company's truth.
voiceover.visual: SDK install + API call; 'No model is called'.

voiceover.text: Every request is checked against its permissions.
voiceover.visual: Authorized / own scope / denied → the exact refusal.

voiceover.text: The agent does the work, and the run is on record.
voiceover.visual: Diff → Runs → Run timeline.

voiceover.text: A solo builder gets a private workspace — and the work state carries into the next session.
voiceover.visual: For myself → Personal workspace → checkpoint → next session restores the work state.

voiceover.text: One company. The person and the agent acted on the same event.
voiceover.visual: One company · NavisLabs: the Navis App and Navis Developer around one shared organizational context; the Acme event reaches both.

voiceover.text: Same facts. Same sources. Same freshness.
voiceover.visual: Same fact / source / freshness, macro by macro.

voiceover.text: One understanding. Two ways in.
voiceover.visual: Thesis; 'People + AI agents · one shared understanding'.

voiceover.text: Models change. Agents change. Tools change.
voiceover.visual: Agent clients swap; the line to NavisLabs holds.

voiceover.text: What it knows stays yours.
voiceover.visual: Agent clients keep changing; the company's record — the same facts with their sources and freshness — stays put.

voiceover.text: Company-owned. Model-neutral. Shared by people and agents.
voiceover.visual: Pillars under the company's record: Company-owned · Model-neutral · Shared by people + agents.

voiceover.text: NavisLabs. The shared understanding for your organization.
voiceover.visual: End card: mark + wordmark, headline, both products, navislabs.in.
voiceover.delivery: name, pause, line; let it end in silence

onscreen_copy.disclosure: Interfaces recreated from the Navis source. Acme Corp and all customer data are fictional demo data; some waits shortened. Not yet connected (roadmap): Salesforce, HubSpot, Jira, GitHub, Notion, Zoom, Microsoft 365. Navis Developer is in private preview.
